Lemma
[Differential of $\operatorname {Ad}$]

Source: petersen:page-0068

1. ch2:2.1.7For a Lie group $G$ with inner automorphism $\operatorname {Ad}_h:x\mapsto hxh^{-1}$ and its differential $\operatorname {Ad}_h:\mathfrak g\to \mathfrak g$ at $e$, the differential of $h\mapsto \operatorname {Ad}_h$ is $U\mapsto \operatorname {ad}_U(X)=[U,X]$.
Proof

↗ lem:pet-ch2-ad-differential

\sketch For the flow $F^t$ of a left-invariant field $U$, left invariance gives $F^t(x)=xF^t(e)$ and $DF^t=DR_{F^t(e)}$. Therefore

\[ \frac d{dt}\operatorname {Ad}_{F^t(e)}(X)\Big|_{t=0} =\frac d{dt}\big(DF^{-t}(X|_{F^t(e)})\big)\Big|_{t=0} =L_UX=[U,X], \]

by subsection 1.2 and subsection 1.2.

□
